forward: Authored identity/version/path/hash/term fields equal their exact source fields. authority_state is an intended postimage value for the two pending rows, not observed standing.
inverse: Reconstruct inherited complete rows only from the authored common fields plus exact preserved original admission/lifecycle metadata.
actual_standing: Obtain from exact baseline/delta/qualified Decision and application evidence, never from a prospective authoring label alone.
current_selection: Preserve all 183 live choices; only a separately authorized application can add the two intended choices.
witness_scope: 189 exact inherited rows and two specific pending meanings, no arbitrary serializer or whole-repository theorem.
